label: UniFi AI Pro 4K camera with PoE+
description: 4K (8 MP) AI bullet camera with a gigabit RJ45 port and on-board licence-plate/face detection. Needs PoE+ 802.3at: 11 W alone, 22 W with the AI Theta enhancer attached.
notes: PoE class 802.3at, 25.5 W at the PSE; 11 W bare, 22 W with the enhancer - over 802.3af's 12.95 W ceiling, so it will not boot on an af port. Wired only, and one of the few cameras here with a gigabit port.
